tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Halstrom Capital** is an asset-management firm that runs a portfolio-risk platform on Azure IaaS. The platform consists of 30 Azure VMs (application and calculation tiers) in the West Europe region and produces end-of-day valuation reports that regulators require the firm to be able to reproduce.

**Current Environment:**
- All VMs currently run in a single availability zone in West Europe
- Valuation reports (unstructured files) are written to an Azure Storage account
- The firm's regulator requires documented, periodically tested disaster recovery procedures
- A ransomware incident at a competitor has made the board demand protection against malicious destruction of recovery data

tabs.title: Business Continuity Requirements
tabs.content:
**Recovery Requirements:**
- If the West Europe region becomes unavailable, the risk platform must be recoverable in North Europe with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 2 hours and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 15 minutes
- DR procedures must be tested quarterly **without** impacting the production environment and without initiating an actual failover
- Valuation report files must remain **readable** by the reporting team even while the primary storage region is experiencing an outage, and must also survive the loss of a single datacenter within the primary region
- Recovery infrastructure costs must be minimized — the firm does not want to pay for a continuously running duplicate environment in North Europe
